verdict.rationale: The docs say the SDK can 'manage background processes' and run shell commands with streaming output. They position sandboxes for AI agents and CI/CD, and mention automating Git operations. These are primitives a developer must wire into their own Worker logic, not a ready-made automation feature. A community report also notes that containers auto-shut down when they stop receiving requests, which limits long-running autonomous work. Missing for 10: built-in scheduling/cron or event triggers for autonomous runs, documented long-running background lifecycle guarantees, and hands-on corroboration of unattended background automation.
